Meet the @kartell_official Masters chair ✨

A design mash-up of three 20th-century icons in one seat. Created by Philippe Starck and Eugeni Quitllet in 2010, it blends the silhouettes of Eero Saarinen's Tulip chair, Arne Jacobsen's Series 7, and the Eames' Eiffel chair into a single, playful form. 

Made from injection-moulded polycarbonate, each chair is produced from one continuous piece. It’s lightweight, stackable, and just as at home outdoors as it is indoors.

WIN a true design classic, reimagined for today ✨ 

Few pieces capture the spirit of British furniture design quite like the ercol Windsor Tub Chair.

Designed by Lucian R. Ercolani between 1955 and 1960, the Windsor is an enduring icon of British design — celebrating timeless style, natural materials and exceptional craftsmanship. Made in Britain for over 60 years, its distinctive design remains as relevant today as ever.

The relationship between ercol and Barker and Stonehouse spans more than 80 years, built on shared values of quality, heritage and furniture made to last. The Windsor was one of the first pieces selected by Barker and Stonehouse founder Charles Barker to feature in-store, marking the beginning of a partnership that continues today.

Now, the iconic design has been reimagined exclusively for Barker and Stonehouse. Crafted from solid ash at ercol’s state-of-the-art factory in Princes Risborough, the 7305 Windsor Tub Chair features its signature steam-bent back rail and sculptural timber spindles.
